s0201.literal: Sorting officials was originally meant to remedy the abuse of excessive appointments under Ahmad.
s0201.idiomatic: Sorting officials was originally meant to remedy Ahmad's abuse of excessive appointments.

s0202.literal: Yet officers and commanders who had won merit are being purged according to routine—how is this to encourage those who follow?
s0202.idiomatic: Yet meritorious officers and commanders are being purged by routine—how will that encourage those who come after?

s0203.literal: Newly attached soldiers should be granted clothing and grain by the branch secretariat so they do not go short.
s0203.idiomatic: Newly attached soldiers should receive clothing and grain from the branch secretariat so they are not left wanting.

s0204.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.
s0204.idiomatic: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.

s0205.literal: Song grand councilors Ma Tingluan and Zhang Jian were summoned to court.
s0205.idiomatic: Song grand councilors Ma Tingluan and Zhang Jian were summoned to court.

s0206.literal: On jiawu day the ban on alcohol was lifted.
s0206.idiomatic: On jiawu day the ban on alcohol was lifted.

s0207.literal: The offices of Ahmad's sons Husin, Asanxian, and others were restored.
s0207.idiomatic: The offices of Ahmad's sons Husin, Asanxian, and others were restored.

s0208.literal: Earlier Husin and the others had been dismissed because Cui Bin had impeached them; now, at Zhang Hui's request, they were restored.
s0208.idiomatic: Earlier Husin and the others had been dismissed after Cui Bin impeached them; now, at Zhang Hui's request, they were restored.

s0209.literal: Hui also asked to restore his son Masu Hu and his nephews Baiduludin and Shamsuddin to their former posts; the Emperor distrusted Hui and did not agree.
s0209.idiomatic: Hui also asked to restore his son Masu Hu and his nephews Baiduludin and Shamsuddin to their former posts; the Emperor distrusted Hui and refused.

s0210.literal: An edict ordered that officials who had been appointed but did not take up their posts be struck from the register and made farmers.
s0210.idiomatic: An edict ordered officials who had been appointed but never took office struck from the register and made farmers.

s0211.literal: On dingyou day Chen Yan was summoned to court for audience.
s0211.idiomatic: On dingyou day Chen Yan was summoned to court for audience.

s0212.literal: On jihai day two thousand ingots of notes were loaned to Imperial Guard garrison-farming troops to buy cattle and implements.
s0212.idiomatic: On jihai day two thousand ingots of notes were loaned to Imperial Guard garrison-farming troops to buy cattle and farm tools.

s0213.literal: On xinchou day Huang Hua of Zhenghe County, Jianning, gathered salt laborers, linked up with Jianning, Kuocang, and townspeople, and with a woman styling herself Madam Xu raised rebellion; troops were ordered mobilized to suppress them.
s0213.idiomatic: On xinchou day Huang Hua of Zhenghe County in Jianning gathered salt laborers, linked up with people in Jianning, Kuocang, and nearby towns, and with a woman calling herself Madam Xu raised rebellion; troops were ordered out to suppress them.

s0214.literal: On dingwei day the mobile Central Secretariat moved its seat from Yangzhou to Hangzhou; a Huai-east Pacification Commission was established at Yangzhou, with Alaghan as pacification commissioner.
s0214.idiomatic: On dingwei day the mobile Central Secretariat moved from Yangzhou to Hangzhou; a Huai-east pacification commission was set up at Yangzhou, with Alaghan as pacification commissioner.

s0215.literal: An edict instructed coastal offices to permit Japanese merchant vessels to trade.
s0215.idiomatic: An edict instructed coastal offices to allow Japanese merchant vessels to trade.

s0216.literal: Associate Administrator Cheng Pengfei was ordered to conduct Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner affairs.
s0216.idiomatic: Associate administrator Cheng Pengfei was ordered to conduct Jinghu north circuit pacification commissioner affairs.

s0217.literal: In the intercalary month, on the gengxu new moon, the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and the southwestern tribal chief Wei Changsheng both submitted; an edict made A Zha and Wei Changsheng pacification commissioners of their respective territories, each granted a tiger tally.
s0217.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on the gengxu new moon, the lord of Luoshi Ghost Country A Zha and the southwestern tribal chief Wei Changsheng both submitted; an edict made A Zha and Wei Changsheng pacification commissioners of their respective territories, each with a tiger tally.

s0218.literal: On xinhai day Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered in the Room mansion.
s0218.idiomatic: On xinhai day Venus, Mars, and Saturn gathered in the Room mansion.

s0219.literal: On jiayin day the Emperor visited the Directorate of Foodstuffs.
s0219.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Emperor visited the directorate of foodstuffs.

s0220.literal: On bingchen day an edict ordered Tulüchi, together with one Tanzhou branch secretariat official, to investigate prefectures and counties along the route of garrison troops returning sick that had failed to care for them.
s0220.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered Tulüchi, together with one Tanzhou branch secretariat official, to investigate prefectures and counties that had failed to care for garrison troops returning sick along their route.

s0221.literal: On jiazi day Mongol and Han army grand marshal Zhang Hongfan attacked Zhang Prefecture, taking one hundred fifty mountain stockades and 1,010,000 households.
s0221.idiomatic: On jiazi day Mongol and Han army grand marshal Zhang Hongfan attacked Zhang Prefecture, taking one hundred fifty mountain stockades and 1,010,000 households.

s0222.literal: That same day scouts reported Wen Tianxiang encamped at Chaoyang Harbor; vanguard Zhang Hongzheng and zongguan Nangadai were urgently dispatched with five hundred light cavalry, overtook him at the foot of Wupo Ridge, routed his force, beheaded more than seven thousand, and escorted Wen Tianxiang and four of his commanders to the capital.
s0222.idiomatic: That same day scouts reported Wen Tianxiang encamped at Chaoyang Harbor; vanguard Zhang Hongzheng and zongguan Nangadai were urgently sent with five hundred light cavalry, overtook him at the foot of Wupo Ridge, routed his force, beheaded more than seven thousand, and escorted Wen Tianxiang and four of his commanders to the capital.

s0223.literal: Twelfth month, jimao day: Zan Shun, signatory of the Western Sichuan Branch Privy Council, induced Duzhang barbarians and one hundred ten of their dependents to submit; their leader A Yong was made Southwestern Tribal Pacification Commissioner, Delanniu was made Duzhang Barbarian Pacification Commissioner, granted tiger tallies, and the rest received patent edicts and gold and silver tallies in graded amounts.
s0223.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jimao day: Zan Shun, signatory of the Western Sichuan branch privy council, induced Duzhang barbarians and one hundred ten of their dependents to submit; their leader A Yong was made southwestern tribal pacification commissioner, Delanniu was made Duzhang barbarian pacification commissioner and granted a tiger tally, and the rest received patent edicts and gold and silver tallies in graded amounts.

s0224.literal: On gengchen day Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian and Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian asked to return Zhenyuan and Huangping, two cities formerly borrowed from Song, and to withdraw garrison troops; this was not granted.
s0224.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian and Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian asked to return Zhenyuan and Huangping, two cities formerly borrowed from Song, and to withdraw garrison troops; the request was denied.

s0225.literal: Jingxian and the others asked that an edict be issued forbidding garrison troops from harassing the people of Sizhou and Bozhou; this was granted.
s0225.idiomatic: Jingxian and the others asked for an edict forbidding garrison troops from harassing the people of Sizhou and Bozhou; the request was granted.

s0226.literal: One thousand newly attached southern-campaign troops under Qincha, pacification commissioner of Yachi and other places, who could not support themselves were ordered to garrison-farm at Jingzhao.
s0226.idiomatic: One thousand newly attached southern-campaign troops under Qincha, pacification commissioner of Yachi and other places, who could not support themselves were ordered to garrison-farm at Jingzhao.

s0227.literal: On yiyou day Bayan submitted the names of meritorious soldiers and surrendered officials from the Yangzi crossing pacification of Shayang, Xincheng, Yangluo Fort, Min, Zhe, and other commanderies; those granted tiger tallies were ordered to come to audience; ranks below qianhu were all to receive appointment from the branch secretariat.
s0227.idiomatic: On yiyou day Bayan submitted the names of meritorious soldiers and surrendered officials from the Yangzi crossing pacification of Shayang, Xincheng, Yangluo Fort, Min, Zhe, and other commanderies; those granted tiger tallies were ordered to court; ranks below qianhu were all to receive appointment from the branch secretariat.

s0228.literal: On bingxu day the Yangzhou branch secretariat submitted one hundred thirty-four officers and commanders for military merit; appointments were granted in varying amounts.
s0228.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Yangzhou branch secretariat submitted one hundred thirty-four officers and commanders for military merit; appointments were granted in graded amounts.

s0229.literal: On bingshen day, at Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian's request, Dingshan was again placed under Bozhou jurisdiction.
s0229.idiomatic: On bingshen day, at Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian's request, Dingshan was again placed under Bozhou.

s0230.literal: On gengzi day Changchun Palace was ordered to perform a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand jiao.
s0230.idiomatic: On gengzi day Changchun Palace was ordered to perform a seven-day-and-night Golden Register grand jiao.

s0231.literal: On bingwu day logging, gathering, fishing, and hunting at Jade Spring Mountain were forbidden.
s0231.idiomatic: On bingwu day logging, gathering, fishing, and hunting at Jade Spring Mountain were forbidden.

s0232.literal: On wushen day, because the Tulao barbarians of Xuzhou and other places had killed envoy Sariman, troops were ordered mobilized to suppress them.
s0232.idiomatic: On wushen day, because the Tulao barbarians of Xuzhou and other places had killed envoy Sariman, troops were ordered out to suppress them.

s0233.literal: Boyi was enfeoffed as Duke of Manifest Righteousness and Clear Grace; Shuqi was enfeoffed as Duke of Honored Forbearance and Benevolent Grace.
s0233.idiomatic: Boyi was enfeoffed as Duke of Manifest Righteousness and Clear Grace; Shuqi as Duke of Honored Forbearance and Benevolent Grace.

s0234.literal: The calendar for the sixteenth year was granted to Goryeo.
s0234.idiomatic: The calendar for the sixteenth year was granted to Goryeo.

s0235.literal: Hail at Ganyu County, Haizhou damaged the crops; this year's land tax was remitted.
s0235.idiomatic: Hail at Ganyu County in Haizhou damaged the crops; this year's land tax was remitted.

s0236.literal: Nanning, Jiyang, and Wan'an—the three commanderies—submitted.
s0236.idiomatic: Nanning, Jiyang, and Wan'an—the three commanderies—submitted.

s0237.literal: A garrison-farming commissionerate was established on Kaicheng Route; Guang'an County was placed under it.
s0237.idiomatic: A garrison-farming commissionerate was established on Kaicheng Route; Guang'an County was placed under it.

s0238.literal: Linzi, Linqu, and Qinghe were restored as counties.
s0238.idiomatic: Linzi, Linqu, and Qinghe were restored as counties.

s0239.literal: The Fei River was channeled into Xi; silted ponds all became good farmland.
s0239.idiomatic: The Fei River was channeled into Xi; silted ponds all became good farmland.

s0240.literal: The princes were assembled at Dadu; captured Song treasures, jades, vessels, and silks were divided and granted to them.
s0240.idiomatic: The princes were assembled at Dadu; captured Song treasures, jades, vessels, and silks were divided and granted to them.

s0241.literal: The princes and others were granted gold, silver, coin, and silk according to the annual custom.
s0241.idiomatic: The princes and others received gold, silver, coin, and silk as in the annual custom.

s0242.literal: That year in Fengsheng Prefecture of the Western Capital and Zhangde and other places, flood and drought left the people hungry; relief of eighty thousand eight hundred ninety shi of rice, thirty-six thousand forty shi of millet, and more than twenty-four thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of notes was issued.
s0242.idiomatic: That year in Fengsheng Prefecture of the Western Capital and Zhangde and other places, flood and drought left the people hungry; relief of eighty thousand eight hundred ninety shi of rice, thirty-six thousand forty shi of millet, and more than twenty-four thousand eight hundred eighty ingots of notes was issued.

s0243.literal: Fifty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0243.idiomatic: Fifty-two persons were sentenced to death.

s0244.literal: In the sixteenth year, spring, first month, on the jiyou new moon, King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo dispatched his Privy Council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and also present the annual tribute.
s0244.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, on the jiyou new moon of the first month of spring, King Wang Chŏm of Goryeo sent his privy council associate director Kim Panggyŏng to offer congratulations and present the annual tribute.

s0245.literal: On renzi day the Five-Wing tümens' heavy-service scout cavalry were abolished.
s0245.idiomatic: On renzi day the Five-Wing tümens' heavy-service scout cavalry were abolished.

s0246.literal: On guichou day Wang Liangchen said: "Western Sichuan military officers who inherit posts from father to son have served diligently for forty years; I ask that their ranks and titles be conspicuously advanced.
s0246.idiomatic: On guichou day Wang Liangchen said, "Western Sichuan military officers who inherit posts from father to son have served diligently for forty years; I ask that their ranks and titles be conspicuously advanced.

s0248.literal: An edict, because Hainan, Qiongya, Dan, Wan, and all commanderies were fully pacified, ordered Ala Haiya to come to court for audience.
s0248.idiomatic: An edict, because Hainan, Qiongya, Dan, Wan, and all commanderies were fully pacified, ordered Ala Haiya to court for audience.

s0249.literal: Luzhou surrendered subjects Zhao Jin, Wu Dacai, Yuan Yusheng, and others had followed the campaign against Chongqing; their families were killed by rebels; an edict granted notes in graded amounts and handed the rebels' wives and children to Jin and the others.
s0249.idiomatic: Luzhou surrendered subjects Zhao Jin, Wu Dacai, Yuan Yusheng, and others had joined the campaign against Chongqing; their families were killed by rebels; an edict granted notes in graded amounts and handed the rebels' wives and children to Jin and the others.

s0250.literal: An edict ordered Goryeo to establish relay stations at Dahui'ai Prefecture, Dongjing, Liushi, and Beluo—four in all.
s0250.idiomatic: An edict ordered Goryeo to establish relay stations at Dahui'ai Prefecture, Dongjing, Liushi, and Beluo—four in all.

s0251.literal: On jiayin day unregistered troops plundered civilians, and the troops under Prince Jibitenemür were especially violent; the ringleaders were ordered captured and punished by law.
s0251.idiomatic: On jiayin day unregistered troops plundered civilians, and the troops under Prince Jibitenemür were especially violent; the ringleaders were ordered captured and punished by law.

s0252.literal: An edict ordered the Ganzhou branch secretariat moved back to Longxing.
s0252.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Ganzhou branch secretariat moved back to Longxing.

s0254.literal: On xinyou day Hezhou pacification commissioner Wang Li surrendered the city.
s0254.idiomatic: On xinyou day Hezhou pacification commissioner Wang Li surrendered the city.

s0255.literal: Earlier Wang Li had sent a secret envoy to surrender to Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui; the Eastern Chuan branch privy council and Dehui disputed credit; Dehui came alone in a single boat to the foot of the walls, called for Li to come out and surrender, and Chuan-Shu was thereby pacified.
s0255.idiomatic: Earlier Wang Li had sent a secret envoy to surrender to Anxi King's chancellor Li Dehui; the Eastern Chuan branch privy council and Dehui disputed credit; Dehui came alone in a single boat to the foot of the walls, called for Li to come out and surrender, and Chuan-Shu was thereby pacified.

s0256.literal: The Eastern Chuan branch privy council thereupon reported that Li had long resisted the royal army and had once denounced Möngke Khan; he should be executed.
s0256.idiomatic: The Eastern Chuan branch privy council thereupon reported that Li had long resisted the royal army and had once denounced Möngke Khan; he should be executed.

s0257.literal: The Privy Council reported the matter; and the surrendered subject Li Liang also sued Li for having earlier killed his wife and children and seized his property; an edict was thereupon issued to execute Li and confiscate his estate to compensate Liang.
s0257.idiomatic: The Privy Council reported the matter; and the surrendered subject Li Liang also sued Li for having earlier killed his wife and children and seized his property; an edict was thereupon issued to execute Li and confiscate his estate to compensate Liang.

s0258.literal: Afterward the Anxi King's full account of Li's surrender and submission was submitted, stating also that Eastern Chuan privy council officials, angered that Li Dehui had received the surrender, had falsely reported to procure Li's execution.
s0258.idiomatic: Afterward the Anxi King's full account of Li's surrender was submitted, stating also that Eastern Chuan privy council officials, angered that Li Dehui had received the surrender, had falsely reported to procure Li's execution.

s0259.literal: Privy Council officials also held the earlier memorial to have been wrong.
s0259.idiomatic: Privy Council officials also held the earlier memorial to have been wrong.

s0260.literal: The Emperor angrily said: "Do you treat human life as a jest?
s0260.idiomatic: The Emperor angrily said, "Do you treat human life as a jest?

s0261.literal: The envoy to execute Li was dispatched long ago; what good is regret now?
s0261.idiomatic: The envoy to execute Li was dispatched long ago—what good is regret now?

s0262.literal: You have killed a man recklessly—return and await punishment.
s0262.idiomatic: You have killed a man recklessly—return and await punishment.

s0264.literal: It happened that the Anxi King's envoy came again, reporting that Li had not been killed.
s0264.idiomatic: It happened that the Anxi King's envoy came again, reporting that Li had not been killed.

s0265.literal: Li was immediately summoned to court for audience and appointed pacification commissioner of Tongchuan Route, with charge of Hezhou affairs.
s0265.idiomatic: Li was immediately summoned to court and appointed pacification commissioner of Tongchuan Route, with charge of Hezhou affairs.

s0266.literal: On renxu day Chuan-Shu was divided into four circuits: Chengdu and other routes as Sichuan Western Circuit, Guangyuan and other routes as Sichuan Northern Circuit, Chongqing and other routes as Sichuan Southern Circuit, Shunqing and other routes as Sichuan Eastern Circuit—pacification commissions established in each.
s0266.idiomatic: On renxu day Chuan-Shu was divided into four circuits: Chengdu and other routes as Sichuan Western Circuit, Guangyuan and other routes as Sichuan Northern Circuit, Chongqing and other routes as Sichuan Southern Circuit, and Shunqing and other routes as Sichuan Eastern Circuit, with pacification commissions established in each.

s0267.literal: Mongol and Han troops from Chongqing and elsewhere who had joined the campaign were rewarded with thirty-nine thousand nine hundred fifty-one ingots of notes.
s0267.idiomatic: Mongol and Han troops from Chongqing and elsewhere who had joined the campaign were rewarded with thirty-nine thousand nine hundred fifty-one ingots of notes.

s0268.literal: Dingshan County of Bozhou was renamed Bochuan County.
s0268.idiomatic: Dingshan County of Bozhou was renamed Bochuan County.

s0269.literal: On dingmao day Associate Administrator Zan Shun was granted one hundred eighty farming households in Jiangjin County.
s0269.idiomatic: On dingmao day associate administrator Zan Shun was granted one hundred eighty farming households in Jiangjin County.

s0270.literal: On wuchen day Hexi garrison farming was established; farm implements were supplied and officials dispatched to supervise.
s0270.idiomatic: On wuchen day Hexi garrison farming was established; farm implements were supplied and officials dispatched to supervise.

s0271.literal: On jiaxu day Zhang Hongfan led troops pursuing the two Song princes to Yashan stockade; Zhang Shijie came to resist and was defeated; Shijie fled; Prince of Guang Zhao Bing together with his officials all went to their deaths at sea; their gold and treasures were captured and presented.
s0271.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Zhang Hongfan led troops pursuing the two Song princes to Yashan stockade; Zhang Shijie came to resist and was defeated; Shijie fled; Prince of Guang Zhao Bing together with his officials all went to their deaths at sea; their gold and treasures were captured and presented.

s0272.literal: On bingzi day an edict instructed the tribal chiefs of the four cave-dwelling barbarian domains of Youba, Sanmao, and others to submit.
s0272.idiomatic: On bingzi day an edict instructed the tribal chiefs of the four cave-dwelling barbarian domains of Youba, Sanmao, and others to submit.

s0273.literal: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Begirmish was made associate director of the Privy Council.
s0273.idiomatic: Left associate of the Central Secretariat Begirmish was made associate director of the Privy Council.

s0274.literal: The Central Secretariat was forbidden to use Uighur script in official documents, memorials, and reports.
s0274.idiomatic: The Central Secretariat was forbidden to use Uighur script in official documents, memorials, and reports.

s0275.literal: Officials, clerks, and craftsmen of the Miscellaneous Manufactures Bureau and related offices were granted two thousand taels of silver.
s0275.idiomatic: Officials, clerks, and craftsmen of the Miscellaneous Manufactures Bureau and related offices were granted two thousand taels of silver.

s0276.literal: Graded gifts of clothing and notes were granted to Prince Orluk, soldiers under Prince Beg Qaghan, and the troops under Sizhou's Tian Shixian.
s0276.idiomatic: Graded gifts of clothing and notes were granted to Prince Orluk, soldiers under Prince Beg Qaghan, and the troops under Sizhou's Tian Shixian.

s0277.literal: Second month, on the wuyin new moon, the Former Farmer was sacrificed to at the registry field.
s0277.idiomatic: Second month, on the wuyin new moon, the Former Farmer was sacrificed to at the registry field.

s0278.literal: On renwu day Li Prefecture was promoted to a route.
s0278.idiomatic: On renwu day Li Prefecture was promoted to a route.

s0279.literal: Envoys were dispatched to seek descendants of Poyang Zhu Bi, who had mastered the Imperial Ultimate number; his nephew Fu Li came bearing Bi's books; ten thousand commoner households were assigned to Mingli's gold panning.
s0279.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to seek descendants of Poyang Zhu Bi, who had mastered the Imperial Ultimate number; his nephew Fu Li came bearing Bi's books; ten thousand commoner households were assigned to Mingli's gold panning.

s0280.literal: Old grain from Jiangnan grain transport was used to relieve hungry soldiers and civilians.
s0280.idiomatic: Old grain from Jiangnan grain transport was used to relieve hungry soldiers and civilians.

s0281.literal: On guiwei day five guard command offices were added.
s0281.idiomatic: On guiwei day five guard command offices were added.

s0282.literal: An edict ordered Taqamaqar and Sartai to register households in Zhongxing.
s0282.idiomatic: An edict ordered Taqamaqar and Sartai to register households in Zhongxing.

s0283.literal: Director of Astronomy Wang Heng and others said: "In building the observatory at Dadu, the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and sundial gnomon are all made of bronze; the bronze gnomon should be raised to forty feet in height, so the shadow will be longer and more accurate.
s0283.idiomatic: Director of astronomy Wang Heng and others said, "In building the observatory at Dadu, the armillary sphere, clepsydra, and sundial gnomon are all made of bronze; the bronze gnomon should be raised to forty feet in height, so the shadow will be longer and more accurate.

s0284.literal: They also asked that instruments be placed separately at five locations—Shangdu, Luoyang, and others—with observatory officers selected at each.
s0284.idiomatic: They also asked that instruments be placed separately at five locations—Shangdu, Luoyang, and others—with observatory officers selected at each.

s0286.literal: On jiashen day Grand Councillor Alibo asked that the branch Central Secretariat review branch Censorate documents, and also that the branch Censorate submit to the branch secretariat, on the model of censors submitting to the Central Secretariat; this was granted.
s0286.idiomatic: On jiashen day grand councillor Alibo asked that the branch Central Secretariat review branch Censorate documents, and also that the branch Censorate submit to the branch secretariat on the model of censors submitting to the Central Secretariat; the request was granted.

s0287.literal: In preparation for the campaign against Japan, an edict ordered Yangzhou, Hunan, Ganzhou, and Quanzhou—four branch secretariats—to build six hundred warships.
s0287.idiomatic: In preparation for the campaign against Japan, an edict ordered Yangzhou, Hunan, Ganzhou, and Quanzhou—four branch secretariats—to build six hundred warships.

s0288.literal: The Shaoxing Pacification Commission was moved to Chuzhou.
s0288.idiomatic: The Shaoxing pacification commission was moved to Chuzhou.

s0289.literal: On jichou day five thousand Tanzhou branch secretariat troops were mobilized to garrison coastal prefectures and districts.
s0289.idiomatic: On jichou day five thousand Tanzhou branch secretariat troops were mobilized to garrison coastal prefectures and districts.

s0290.literal: On gengyin day Zhang Hongfan, because surrendered subject Chen Yi and his brothers had merit in defeating bandits and had provided one hundred warships for the campaign against the two Song princes, asked that Yi be made pacification commissioner concurrently commander-in-chief of Chaozhou Route military and civilian affairs, and his brothers Zhong, Yi, and Yong be made army commanders; qianhu Talqai had merit in capturing Wen Tianxiang, and was asked to be made commander qianhu with tally—all granted.
s0290.idiomatic: On gengyin day Zhang Hongfan, because surrendered subject Chen Yi and his brothers had merit in defeating bandits and had provided one hundred warships for the campaign against the two Song princes, asked that Yi be made pacification commissioner and concurrently commander-in-chief of Chaozhou Route military and civilian affairs, and his brothers Zhong, Yi, and Yong be made army commanders; qianhu Talqai had merit in capturing Wen Tianxiang and was asked to be made commander qianhu with tally—all granted.

s0291.literal: On renchen day Master Zhang Liusun was instructed by edict to take full charge of Daoism in Huai-east, Huai-west, Jing-Xiang, and other regions.
s0291.idiomatic: On renchen day Master Zhang Liusun was instructed by edict to take full charge of Daoism in Huai-east, Huai-west, Jing-Xiang, and other regions.

s0292.literal: On yiwei day Yusut Temür said: "Having branch Censorate documents reviewed by the branch secretariat is inconvenient in practice.
s0292.idiomatic: On yiwei day Yusut Temür said, "Having branch Censorate documents reviewed by the branch secretariat is inconvenient in practice.

s0293.literal: " An edict changed the arrangement; transport commission documents were left to Censorate review.
s0293.idiomatic: " An edict changed the arrangement; transport commission documents were left to Censorate review.

s0294.literal: Yüguren, darughachi of Raozhou Route, misappropriated four thousand four hundred shi of surplus grain; he was beaten with the staff and his property confiscated.
s0294.idiomatic: Yüguren, darughachi of Raozhou Route, misappropriated four thousand four hundred shi of surplus grain; he was beaten with the staff and his property confiscated.

s0295.literal: An edict ordered the Hunan branch secretariat that along the return route of garrison troops, at every forty or fifty li an Ease-and-Comfort Hall was to be established—to treat the sick, provision the hungry, and coffin-bury the dead, with costs supplied by the government.
s0295.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Hunan branch secretariat that along garrison troops' return route, at every forty or fifty li an Ease-and-Comfort Hall was to be established—to treat the sick, feed the hungry, and coffin-bury the dead, with costs supplied by the government.

s0296.literal: Officials were dispatched to verify lands of escaped commoners in Yidu, Zilai, and Jinan that had been made into mobile camp pasture.
s0296.idiomatic: Officials were dispatched to verify lands of escaped commoners in Yidu, Zilai, and Jinan that had been made into mobile camp pasture.

s0297.literal: Among all ordo households and Han people, possession of bows and arrows was forbidden; weapons carried on campaign were to be turned in to the government arsenal afterward.
s0297.idiomatic: Among all ordo households and Han people, possession of bows and arrows was forbidden; weapons carried on campaign were to be turned in to the government arsenal afterward.

s0298.literal: On renyin day the Directorate of Astronomy was granted one thousand seventy-eight taels of silver.
s0298.idiomatic: On renyin day the directorate of astronomy was granted one thousand seventy-eight taels of silver.

s0299.literal: On guimao day one thousand newly attached troops from Jiading were sent to garrison-farm at Tuoli North.
s0299.idiomatic: On guimao day one thousand newly attached troops from Jiading were sent to garrison-farm at Tuoli North.

s0300.literal: On jiachen day the Dadu Cavalry and Infantry Command was raised to rank four.
s0300.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Dadu cavalry and infantry command was raised to rank four.
